BiblicalUsage: The word ʼushsharnâʼ is the Bible's way of saying a wall. In Ezra 5:3, to make up this wall, and it appears again in Ezra 5:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼushsharnâʼ still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
